passes.knownIssueChecked: emergencyWithdraw forfeits pending reward / skips _syncBudget+_updatePool / callable while paused = intentional escape hatch
passes.whyNotSuppressed: The escape-hatch known issue covers (a) the DEPARTING user forfeiting their own pending reward and (b) preservation of the SOLVENCY invariant (balance == rewardBudget + committedDebt) despite skipping _updatePool. CONFIRMED against CLAUDE.md (Feature Spec item 1; Solvency invariant) and the emergencyWithdraw NatSpec (NFTStaker.sol:525-537): the NatSpec only claims solvency preservation and frames forfeited phUSD as 'recycled into the next recompute' — implying a CLEAN recompute. It does NOT anticipate that emergencyWithdraw also DECREMENTS totalStaked while leaving rewardRate sized for the OLD (larger) pool, so the next _syncBudget runs _updatePool() FIRST (NFTStaker.sol:300, before _recomputeSchedule at 308) with stale rate / smaller totalStaked, inflating accRewardPerShare for SURVIVORS by oldTotal/newTotal over the whole [lastRewardTime, now] window (lastRewardTime is never advanced by emergencyWithdraw). This re-introduces the participation multiplier that the M-03 APY-AS-FLOOR / 'no participation multiplier' invariant (CLAUDE.md Critical Invariants) explicitly forbids. The known issue is about the LEAVER's forfeiture; this is about over-emission to EVERYONE ELSE. Distinct effect, NOT covered. PoC-confirmed (Tier-3 Invariant.t.sol: M-03/runway invariants FAIL, SOLVENCY PASSES => value-leak, not insolvency).

partialMatch.knownIssue: topUp intentionally does not call _syncBudget (preserving dispatcher-hook-independence)
partialMatch.explanation: The DESIGN CHOICE (topUp/setTargetAPY recompute without pull()) IS acknowledged in CLAUDE.md Feature Spec item 7 as intentional. What is NOT acknowledged is the CONSEQUENCE: _recomputeSchedule sizes budget on V = balance + mintDebt (NFTStaker.sol:402-405), so when mintDebt > 0 and no pull() precedes the recompute, rewardBudget is over-stated by exactly the un-pulled mintDebt and the Critical Invariant 'Solvency (always): balance == rewardBudget + committedDebt holds at ALL times' is TRANSIENTLY violated. The reportable delta is the precision gap between the 'holds at all times' claim and the actual eventually-consistent behavior (self-heals on next _syncBudget/pullAndRefresh). Per 'when in doubt, keep the finding' and Law-1 recall, PASS as a QA/Low doc-precision finding; do NOT suppress under the design-choice known issue.

reTriage.why: M-01 was accepted (triage 2026-05-30) partly on the operational ACCEPTANCE INVARIANT 'keep nudge pot < nudgeSize x mintPrice' + 'NFTs have no secondary market (only the staking pool), so a pure MEV bot cannot recoup in one tx'. This run's analysis (ECON-002 / F-03) argues that invariant does NOT bound loss once the minted NFTs carry REALIZABLE value: each loop iteration mints a real, potentially resellable/redeemable NFT to the caller-chosen recipient, so a searcher who can realize NFT value nets ~pot > 0 for ANY pot size, and the giveaway is raced to zero on every refill. This directly undermines the assumption the acceptance rested on. ALSO folded in: the owner over-funding footgun (PATTERN-002) — 'fund the incentive' silently equals 'set a sweepable bounty' — a non-obvious Law-3 footgun that is IN SCOPE per project policy (not auto-invalid).
reTriage.doNotSuppressSilently: Per Law 1 (recall beats report-tidiness), this is surfaced prominently rather than filtered. It is NOT filed as a new ledger entry (same root cause + location as M-01) and the acknowledged status is NOT changed by the sanitizer.

Over-funding facet (PATTERN-002) is a non-obvious Law-3 owner footgun ('fund the incentive' == 'set a sweepable bounty').
